items.source: By default an XhrTransport will be used with "xhr_streaming" first and then with "xhr", if the streaming fails to connect. In some cases it may be useful to suppress streaming so that only "xhr" is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，将首先使用带有"xhr_streaming"的XhrTransport，如果流式传输连接失败，则使用"xhr"。在某些情况下，可能需要抑制流式传输，以便仅使用"xhr"。

items.source: A SockJS Transport that uses HTTP requests to simulate a WebSocket interaction. The connect method of the base Transport interface is used to receive messages from the server while the executeSendRequest(URI, HttpHeaders, TextMessage) method here is used to send messages.
items.translation: 一个使用 HTTP 请求来模拟 WebSocket 交互的 SockJS Transport。基础 Transport 接口的 connect 方法用于从服务器接收消息，而这里的 executeSendRequest(URI, HttpHeaders, TextMessage) 方法则用于发送消息。

items.source: Note that as of 4.2 this method accepts a headers parameter.
items.translation: 注意，自 4.2 版本起，此方法接受一个 `headers` 参数。

items.source: An XhrTransport supports both the "xhr_streaming" and "xhr" SockJS server transports.
items.translation: XhrTransport 支持 "xhr_streaming" 和 "xhr" 这两种 SockJS 服务器传输方式。

items.source: Execute a request to send the message to the server.
items.translation: 执行请求以将消息发送到服务器。
